name: Tier 3: any non-OK status is persisted again
why: The original org/503-handling.org F5 defect: a 503 is written to the IDB `metadata` store exactly like a real 404. The store assertion for the transiently-failed release must notice.

name: Tier 3: no non-OK status is persisted at all
why: The over-broad 'fix'. The 503 half of the test still passes; the 404 half must fail. This is what pins the change as NARROWING negative persistence rather than removing it.

name: Tier 3: the in-memory zero is gated on the status too
why: org/503-handling.org's F5 wording as written, which was deliberately narrowed. Without a session sentinel a transiently-failed entity is re-requested on every filter keystroke and every sort.

name: _artRetryTable: no IDB metadata eviction
why: The pre-fix state. Step 2 clears the session Maps, so _artEnrichIcon misses Tier 1 and then HITS Tier 2 and returns the stored zero with no request: the retry button is a no-op for the whole table.

name: _artRetryTable: the eviction is not awaited
why: KNOWN OVERLAP, recorded rather than omitted. _artIdbDelete and _artIdbGetMetadata share the one cached `_artIdbPromise`, so the delete's readwrite transaction on `metadata` is created before the read's readonly one, and IndexedDB serialises overlapping-scope transactions in creation order; `_caaQueue.enqueue()` defers the read further still. The race cannot be forced from a fixture. The await is kept anyway: it is free, it mirrors _relRetryMbids(), and it saves the next reader from reconstructing that argument.

name: metadata TTL default back to 7 days
why: The seeded 10-day-old record expires at _artIdbGetMetadata() (and is swept by _artIdbSweepExpired()), so the release goes to the network — which the test asserts does not happen.

name: _artIdbGetMetadata fallback back to 7
why: KNOWN UNCOVERABLE. `|| N` fires only when the setting is absent or 0, and `min: 1` plus the schema default make that unreachable through any supported route. Aligned with the new default for consistency, not for behaviour.

name: _artIdbSweepExpired fallback back to 7
why: KNOWN UNCOVERABLE, same reason as the entry above.

name: stats-panel TTL display back to 7
why: KNOWN UNCOVERABLE. A cosmetic string in the Statistics panel, which no fixture spec opens. Listed so the third fallback is not silently unmentioned.
